name: Empty State
description: Centered absence-message composition that explains why expected content is not present and provides optional context and recovery actions. Empty State owns presentation and status communication; the containing pattern owns query/filter logic, request state, empty-case truth, permissions, and recovery behavior.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible non-empty explanation heading. Defaults to the Figma example No people found.

props.name: body
props.description: Optional supporting explanation text. Defaults to the Figma no-results example and is rendered only when showBody is true.
props.default:
No names or email addresses match “zoe”.
Try a different search or clear it to see everyone.

props.name: showBody
props.description: Controls whether the supporting body is visible. It does not change the empty-state reason or request state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional compatible decorative icon content. When omitted, the approved Search source is used; the icon never owns the message or an action.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Controls whether the decorative icon region is visible.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional recovery or next-step controls. Prefer one Button or Link and use no more than two direct actions; behavior remains owned by the containing pattern.

anatomy.name: surface
anatomy.description: Host-filling default surface with a 440px minimum block size in the Figma authority.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Centered vertical content stack with 12px gaps and a 680px maximum inline size.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional 40px decorative icon region containing a centered 24px compatible system icon.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible non-empty heading that remains present even when optional icon and body context are hidden.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Optional supporting text controlled by showBody and preserving authored line breaks.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional recovery controls composed from existing public Button or Link sources. Figma allows at most two preferred controls.

semantics.element: section containing a heading and a polite status text group
semantics.accessibleName: The visible non-empty title labels the empty region; optional supporting body text adds explanation without replacing the title.
semantics.keyboardActivation: Only composed recovery controls provide keyboard activation.
semantics.focus: Empty State does not move focus when it appears. Recovery controls participate in normal document focus order.
requirements: The visible title is a discoverable heading, remains non-empty, and labels the empty region.
The title and visible body are exposed through a polite status message so relevant result changes can be announced without an alert interruption.
Recovery actions remain outside the status live region so interactive control labels are not repeatedly announced as message content.
Showing the Empty State must not move focus unexpectedly; the containing pattern decides whether any separate focus management is required.
The icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology so it does not repeat or compete with the textual explanation.
When showBody is true, body text remains non-empty; when showBody is false, the title alone remains the explanation.
The Figma source uses a 440px minimum surface block size, a centered content stack capped at 680 CSS pixels, 12px inter-item gaps, and a 40px icon region containing a centered 24px glyph.
The implementation fills the host inline size rather than turning the 1168px Figma example width into a fixed public component width.
Empty State does not own loading, error handling, query/filter logic, result counts, empty-case reasoning, permissions, or recovery outcomes.

icon.description: Compatible decorative icon content rendered inside the governed icon region; the default uses the existing Search asset.

actions.description: Recovery or next-step controls supplied by the workflow. Prefer one existing Button or Link; Figma caps the preferred slot at two controls.
